Hi Sarah — great to hear, and thanks for sending the metadata and IP list.

Below is a compact mutual action plan we usually use for enterprise access controls. I attached our onboarding checklist (redwood-access-onboard-checklist.pdf) — please treat as our canonical preflight. High level:

1) SSO (SAML):
   - We require IdP metadata + expected NameID format.
   - Default attribute mapping: email -> email, given_name, family_name, groups(optional).
   - If you need custom role mapping, we'll need an attribute map doc a week before staging.

2) SCIM provisioning:
   - SCIM v2 endpoint + admin token (provisioning account) or a temporary Okta service app.
   - We support group sync and delta sync; recommend group delta every 5 minutes for fast user churn customers.

3) IP allowlist & network:
   - We will provide the client-facing egress IPs for webhook callbacks and token retrievals (short list).
   - Please confirm whether your firewall team requires CIDR ranges or single IPs.

4) Service accounts & org policies:
   - Pattern: one long-lived provisioning SA per environment (staging/prod) with scoped API keys; short-lived deploy tokens for CI.
   - Rotation: recommend quarterly rotation for long-lived keys; we can support automated rotation on Dedicated/Private.

Proposed next steps:
- Tech kickoff: 30m call this Friday 10:00am PT (I can host).
- Deliverables due from AtlasRx by Tue 5/18: signed checklist, SCIM admin token, SAML attribute map.
- Redwood owners: Mina (access), Ben (service accounts), Priyom (scim/ops).

If that looks ok I’ll book the call and loop engineering for the service-account mapping walk-through.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
